release_highlights: Free-radio master logs are active under logbook_flr and remain separate from amateur logbook data.
Free-radio tabs support up to four simultaneous tabs, unlimited logbook creation, light-blue selected styling, recall, and duplicate-tab prevention.
Free-radio calls use hiragana plus ASCII letters/digits; Katakana is normalized to hiragana.
Free-radio log identity is call + type + optional model + year; model suggestions come from existing free-radio logbooks.
CB/LCR/DCR/UHFCB/特小/BLU/ETC map automatically to stored BAND/MODE values.
Free-radio LogSearch crosses types for the same own call and displays type instead of BAND/MODE.
Dedicated free-radio search/edit remains isolated from amateur search/edit.
Windows release package filenames derive version from storage.VERSION.
Free-radio create-dialog validation retains user input and model name is optional.
